title: Secretary Rubio’s Travel to Reykjavík, Athens, and Lisbon
author: Office of the Spokesman
summary:
Office of the Spokesman

Secretary Rubio’s Travel to Reykjavík, Athens, and Lisbon

Media Note

October 1, 2026

Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel to Reykjavík, Iceland; Athens, Greece; and Lisbon, Portugal from October 5-8, 2026.

Secretary Rubio will meet with Icelandic officials in Reykjavík to discuss economic and security collaboration.  In Greece, Secretary Rubio will lead the United States delegation for the Sixth U.S.-Greece Strategic Dialogue, deepening our partnership on key Administration priorities, including defense cooperation and regional and energy security.  Secretary Rubio will then travel to Lisbon to meet with Portuguese officials to advance defense, economic, and technology cooperation.
